Concise Clinical Note

Consult Summary:
Young woman with rapidly progressive lip swelling, throat tightness, and dyspnea after eating prawn soup – suspected anaphylaxis; emergency services activated.

History:
• Presenting complaint: Swelling of upper lip began ~30 min after prawn soup; progressive enlargement, throat tightness, breathing difficulty, dizziness.  
• Associated symptoms: Chest feels “tight,” no clear chest pain; no mention of rash, abdominal pain, or vomiting.  
• Past similar episode: 1 year ago after late-night Chinese meal; woke with facial swelling and breathing difficulty; no details of treatment.  
• Past medical history: Asthma; known peanut allergy with childhood hospitalization for severe reaction.  
• Medications: Salbutamol inhaler (dose/route/frequency not documented); “sometimes” takes antihistamines (agent/dose/frequency not documented).  
• Allergies: Peanut (food) – anaphylaxis risk. Drug allergies not documented.  
• Social / preventive: Lives with mother; no other social history recorded.

Examination:
Vitals: Not documented (remote video call).  
Findings (patient-reported): Visible upper-lip swelling; patient reports throat swelling, dyspnea, dizziness.

Impression:
Suspected acute anaphylaxis triggered by shellfish (prawn).

Plan:
• Immediate action: Call emergency medical services (999) for transport to hospital – communicated during call.  
• Interim: Take available oral antihistamine while awaiting ambulance.  
• Supervision: Remain with family member until EMS arrive.  
• Follow-up: After hospital discharge, patient to contact clinic for review, consideration of epinephrine auto-injector prescription and allergy management plan.

Quality checks:
● Missing expected elements: Detailed drug allergy list; full medication reconciliation (including controllers for asthma); vitals; dose/route/frequency of current meds and antihistamine given; immunization status.  
● Internal conflicts: None noted.  
● Transcript quality: Clear audio; minor conversational interruptions, no significant data loss.
